originality.rationale: The main contribution is the arbitrary positive run-vector formula and equality of minimal DFA sizes before and after scattered-subsequence closure. Guyot (2024, Propositions 2.5–2.6) already establishes the all-run-lengths-one specialization for the downward closure of conjugates of a word of pairwise distinct letters: its complexity is q²−q+3; this special case is expressly not claimed new. An earlier two-run conjugacy calculation supplies q=2 for the unclosed language only. Neither prior statement implies the full multirun identity; residual equivalence remains a risk.
residual_risks: The all-unit run-vector specialization is previously known (Guyot 2024, Prop. 2.6); this result claims only the full nonunit extension and closure invariance.
Possible unindexed equivalence for arbitrary positive run lengths and a prior general reduction from the unit case.
